title: Alignment Check Charges on Customer-Paid Calibration Work — Insurance Claim Repairs
content:
Once the calibration is the customer's, the alignment checks made for it are the customer's. On a denied-operation addition to an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order where a calibration line remains — a calibration line above zero — alignment charges are read from the ADAS Sensor Calibrations order of the repair order: whether its tier requires an alignment, the alignment checks recorded on the order, and which of them found the vehicle out of spec and were corrected. The fees are the tier's alignment check fee and alignment correction fee.

## Decision table

| Calibration line remains | Order's tier requires an alignment | Alignment checks on the order | At least one out-of-spec check corrected | Alignment charges |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | one or more | yes | every check at the tier's alignment check fee, and every corrected check also at the tier's alignment correction fee, rounded to the cent |
| yes | yes | one or more | no | one alignment check fee |
| yes | yes | none | — | none |
| yes | no | any | any | none |
| no | any | any | any | none |

**Clause.** When the order's tier requires an alignment and an out-of-spec check on the order was corrected, every alignment check on the order is charged at the tier's alignment check fee and every corrected check also at the tier's alignment correction fee; when the tier requires an alignment and the order carries checks but none was corrected, one alignment check fee is charged; when no calibration line remains, or in any other case, no alignment charge applies.

## Hypothetical order (fees supposed for illustration: check fee USD 60.00, correction fee USD 90.00; tier requires an alignment; calibration line remains)

- Three checks, one corrected: three checks at USD 60.00, USD 180.00, and one correction at USD 90.00 — USD 270.00.
- Two checks, none corrected: one check fee, USD 60.00.
- The same two checks, but the insurer approved the calibration in full so no calibration line remains: none.
